name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act
summary: Guarantees at least 100 days of unskilled wage employment in a financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.

eligibility_clauses.text: The applicant must be a member of a rural household.
The applicant must be an adult (18 years or older) willing to do unskilled manual work.

entitlement_rules.text: Each rural household is guaranteed up to 100 days of wage employment per financial year, paid at the notified daily wage rate.

appeal_hierarchy.description: Complaint to the Programme Officer at block level.
Escalation to the District Programme Coordinator.
